title: Disambiguating Moral Circuits and Moral Features in Language Models: Moral content, normative judgment or cue words? Evidence from 14 models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interpretability methods can locate the attention heads and sparse autoencoder (SAE) features that change the answer a language model gives to a moral prompt, e.g., whether "Stealing medicine for a dying child is morally" continues with "justified" or "wrong". Such a component could respond to moral content, to the judgment of conduct by any norm, or to the word "morally" in the prompt. We built 227 minimal pairs of short phrases, validated by five annotators, whose two versions differ in a moral standard, in another kind of norm (prudence, etiquette, aesthetics or evidence) or in a descriptive quality, and showed them to 14 open-weight models (Llama, Gemma and Qwen, 1B to 14B, base and instruction-tuned), with and without the word "morally". In every model, the heads that change the moral answer belong to an evaluation circuit the models use for every kind of normative judgment we tested: these heads carry the same share of the effect

translated_title: 消解语言模型中道德回路与道德特征的歧义：道德内容、规范性判断还是线索词？来自14个模型的证据
translated_abstract: 可解释性方法能够定位那些改变语言模型对道德提示所给出答案的注意力头和稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征，例如“为垂死的孩子偷药在道德上是”这句话会续接“正当的”还是“错误的”。这样的组件可能响应的是道德内容、以任何规范对行为的判断，或是提示中的“道德上”一词。我们构建了227对经五名标注者验证的短语最小对，其两个版本分别在道德标准、另一种规范（审慎、礼仪、审美或证据）或描述性属性上存在差异，并将它们呈现给14个开源权重模型（Llama、Gemma和Qwen，参数量1B至14B，包括基础版和指令微调版），提示词中分别包含或不包含“道德上”一词。在每一个模型中，改变道德答案的注意力头都属于模型在所有被测试的规范性判断类型中所使用的同一个评估回路：这些注意力头承担了相同比例的效应……
tldr: 通过227对最小短语对和14个开源模型的实验，研究发现改变语言模型道德答案的注意力头并非道德专属，而是属于一个对所有类型规范性判断共用的通用评估回路，其效应与“道德上”这一线索词无关。
en_tdlr: Experiments with 227 minimal phrase pairs across 14 open-weight models show that the attention heads shifting a model's moral answers are not moral-specific, but belong to a shared evaluation circuit used for every kind of normative judgment tested, independent of the cue word "morally."
